Read input: rtlpp_05146_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_05146 (
    address,
    chipselect,
    clk,
    reset_n,
    write_n,
    writedata,
    out_port,
    readdata
);

  output [9:0] out_port;
  output [31:0] readdata;
  input [1:0] address;
  input chipselect;
  input clk;
  input reset_n;
  input write_n;
  input [31:0] writedata;

reg [9:0] data_out;
wire [9:0] read_mux_out;

// Generate the read multiplexer output
assign read_mux_out = (address == 0) ? data_out : 10'b0;

// Write logic for data_out
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (!reset_n)
        data_out <= 10'b0;
    else if (chipselect && ~write_n && (address == 0))
        data_out <= writedata[9:0];
end

// Assign readdata to be the read_mux_out aligned to 32 bits
assign readdata = {22'b0, read_mux_out};

// Assign out_port to data_out
assign out_port = data_out;

endmodule
